title: ScoreFlow: Mastering LLM Agent Workflows via Score-based Preference Optimization
authors: Yinjie Wang; Ling Yang; Guohao Li; Mengdi Wang; Bryon Aragam
affiliations: University of Chicago (Yinjie Wang, Bryon Aragam);

problem_statement.en: Existing automated agentic-workflow optimization methods are inflexible: they rely on rigid workflow representations, produce a single static workflow for an entire task set (poor adaptability/scalability), and use discrete optimization (e.g. MCTS in AFlow, iterative failed-case refinement in ADAS) that converges prematurely and incurs high API costs. The goal is to automatically generate, for each input query, an adaptive multi-agent workflow that maximizes task performance at low cost.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的自動化 agentic-workflow 最佳化方法缺乏彈性:其依賴僵化的 workflow 表徵,對整個任務集僅產生單一靜態 workflow(適應性與可擴充性不佳),並採用離散最佳化(例如 AFlow 的 MCTS、ADAS 的迭代式失敗案例修正),導致過早收斂且產生高昂的 API 成本。本研究目標為針對每一筆輸入 query,自動生成能在低成本下最大化任務表現的自適應 multi-agent workflow。

key_innovation.en: An open-source LLM workflow generator that emits per-query Python-code workflows is fine-tuned by gradient-based optimization in continuous parameter space using Score-DPO, a DPO variant that (1) up-weights preference pairs by their measured task-score difference and (2) scales the implicit DPO rewards by monotone functions of the raw evaluation scores, so more-confident/higher-scoring workflows exert proportionally larger influence on the loss.
key_innovation.zh: 本研究提出一個開源的 LLM workflow 生成器,可針對每一筆 query 輸出以 Python 程式碼表示的 workflow,並透過 Score-DPO 在連續參數空間中以梯度式最佳化進行 fine-tune。Score-DPO 為 DPO 之變體,其(1)依據所量測的任務分數差異,對偏好對(preference pair)加權;(2)以原始評估分數的單調函數縮放隱式 DPO reward,使置信度較高、分數較高的 workflow 對損失施加成比例的更大影響。

baselines_compared: IO, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Consistency CoT, MedPrompt, MultiPersona Debate, Self-Refine, ADAS, AFlow, SFT, PPO

key_improvements.en: Avg 85.3% vs AFlow 80.6%; 8B generator exceeds API-model generators; Score-DPO > SFT/PPO/DPO on every dataset.
key_improvements.zh: 六評測平均 85.3% 對 AFlow 80.6%;8B 生成器優於 API 模型生成器;Score-DPO 在所有資料集勝過 SFT/PPO/DPO。

structure_space: Workflow code, Operator / node graph, Prompts (joint), Team composition (agent set)
optimization_signal: Task utility (accuracy), Preference pairs, Validation-set score
benchmarks_used: HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH, DROP, HotpotQA

agent_scenario.en: Task-solving multi-agent workflows within a single domain per benchmark (QA / coding / math). A trained generator LLM emits a Python-coded workflow composed of predefined reusable operators (agents): Custom, CustomCodeGenerate, AnswerGenerate, Programmer (writes+executes Python), ScEnsemble (selects best of multiple solutions), Review, Test (runs public test cases), and a final Answer-Extractor Agent appended after the final response. A separate executor LLM runs the generated workflow to produce the answer. Agent-set size is adaptive per task (workflows range from 1 agent to 5+), and operator system prompts are customizable by the generator. Operator design follows the AFlow framework.
agent_scenario.zh: 每個 benchmark 在單一領域(QA/coding/math)內的任務求解 multi-agent workflow。一個經訓練的生成器 LLM 輸出以 Python 程式碼表示的 workflow,其由預先定義且可重複使用的 operator(agent)組成:Custom、CustomCodeGenerate、AnswerGenerate、Programmer(撰寫並執行 Python)、ScEnsemble(從多個解中選取最佳者)、Review、Test(執行公開測試案例),以及附加於最終回應之後的 Answer-Extractor Agent。另有一個獨立的執行器 LLM 執行所生成的 workflow 以產出答案。Agent 集合的規模依任務自適應調整(workflow 由 1 個 agent 至 5 個以上不等),且 operator 的 system prompt 可由生成器自訂。Operator 設計沿用 AFlow 框架。
